entries.223a7f2355de9512: This business manufactures and sells automobile parts such as truck frames, axles, and panels, and automobile dies. It has production bases in Japan, Thailand, the United States, China, Sweden, and Indonesia. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥166,558 million, making it the largest business, accounting for more than 8-tenths of consolidated net sales. Its main customer is [[company:isuzu-motors|ISUZU MOTORS LIMITED]].
entries.2df72faf1e01d2f8: Its strength lies in positioning frames, axles, cabs for construction machinery and panels as "core products," and in being able to produce products for electric vehicles using existing production facilities. It cites pursuit of technology development, proposal capability and manufacturing capability, including construction of production lines that carry out everything from drilling and forming through to painting in an integrated manner.

entries.496916274c451978: The five-year medium-term management plan for the fiscal years 2024 to 2028 sets out the basic policy of "Pursuing quality and enhancing presence," and advances efforts based on three pillars: "offense and challenge in core businesses," "evolution of core products for electrification," and "promotion of sustainability management." The corporate slogan is "Toward creation beyond manufacturing," and its mission is to remain a force that supports people, vehicles and machinery through manufacturing. The medium-term management plan had set a revenue target of ¥240 billion for the fiscal year ended March 2026.
